Name: (CP) Leah Busty Cleavage With Freckels
Author: Master2873
Description:
I made a portrait mod of, Leah of her busty cleavage version with either, only facial freckles, or freckles on her face, and chest (If really wanted, I can make a chest only if people are wanting it). Since my tastes are different, and saw nothing like it for Leah so far. Also made for Content Patcher!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]﻿

-[url=https://www.smapi.io/] SMAPI 2.0 or higher[/url]﻿
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]

- After installing, SMAPI, and Content Patcher, extract the zip file, and navigate to, "[i]Stardew Valley/Mods"[/i] ﻿and drop/move/extract the folder there.
[size=5]
[b]- Configuration[/b][/size]

- To change the type of portrait, open the [i]"config.json" [/i]file with Wordpad, or Notepad+, then where it looks like this:

{
  "Leah": "Leah_Freckles"
}

Just simply change the [i]"Leah_Freckels"[/i], to [i]"Leah_Freckels_Full" [/i], and you're good!

I'll be including a .txt file in the zip as well of how to change this, and if for some reason, you can't remember the names, or want to change them, just open the "[i]Content.json" [/i]file. You'll see the names at the top, and can change the required names for the assets granted you changed the name of the assets as well.

Downloads.Description: Changes portrait of Leah, in her busty form, with cleavage, and freckles,or facial and chest covered freckles.
